title: Sagittarius Zodiac Sign: Personality, Love, Career & Compatibility
intro: Sagittarius (November 22 – December 21) is the adventurous fire sign ruled by Jupiter. Optimistic, funny and free-spirited, Sagittarius is always aiming for the next horizon.
personality: Sagittarius loves freedom, travel, big ideas and honest laughs. They are natural optimists who believe tomorrow can be better than today. Curious about cultures and philosophy, they are lifelong learners. Their honesty can be blunt, but it comes from a good place.
love: Sagittarius wants a partner who is also a best friend and travel buddy. Freedom, humor and shared adventures matter more than rules. With trust and space, they are warm and generous lovers.
career: Sagittarius thrives in travel, teaching, publishing, sports, tourism, international business and any job with variety and meaning.
friendship: Sagittarius is the friend who plans the road trip, tells the funniest stories and makes you believe in yourself.

faq.q: What is the Sagittarius personality like?
faq.ans: Sagittarius is adventurous, optimistic, honest and loves freedom.

faq.q: Who is Sagittarius most compatible with?
faq.ans: Sagittarius usually matches well with Aries, Leo and Aquarius.

faq.q: What is the lucky stone of Sagittarius?
faq.ans: Turquoise is the classic lucky stone for Sagittarius.
